name: Amber & Oud
tagline: Deep, smoky warmth for quiet evenings
about: A rich and grounding blend of warm amber resin and rare oud wood. This candle fills your space with a luxurious, smoky depth that lingers long after the flame goes out. Perfect for evenings when you want to unwind and feel anchored. Hand-poured in small batches using 100% natural soy wax.

name: Warm Vanilla
about: Soft, creamy, and instantly comforting — Warm Vanilla is the olfactory equivalent of a warm hug. Notes of toasted vanilla bean, caramel, and a hint of coconut make this candle a crowd favorite. Ideal for bedrooms, reading nooks, or any space you want to feel cozy.

name: Cedar + Sage
about: Breathe in the clean, earthy calm of a morning forest walk. Cedar + Sage blends crisp white sage with warm cedarwood and a whisper of eucalyptus — cleansing without being sharp. Great for home offices, yoga spaces, or anywhere you need clarity and focus.

name: White Tea
about: Delicate and refined, White Tea captures the serene feeling of a quiet morning ritual. Gentle notes of fresh white tea leaves, soft jasmine, and powdery musk create a clean, airy scent that never overwhelms. A minimalist's dream candle — understated luxury at its best.

name: Rose & Neroli
about: An ode to femininity and quiet confidence. Rose & Neroli weaves together the full-bodied richness of Turkish rose with the bright, delicate sparkle of neroli blossom. A touch of warm musk at the base keeps it grounded and sensual. Beautifully gift-worthy.
